# Project Context Routing

Read the root `AGENTS.md` for shared execution rules. If this session did not load it automatically,
open `AGENTS.md` at the repository root now.

| Task | Document |
| --- | --- |
| Any change | `docs/project.md` |
| Behavior change | `docs/specs/widget-export.md` |
| Structure | `docs/architecture/overview.md` |

Otherwise start from `docs/README.md`. `docs/` is the only canonical home for specs and plans here.
